═══ FULL tests/unit GREEN + commit SHA ═══

`pytest tests/unit -q` (whole unit tier, in the fix worktree): **6452 passed, 19 skipped**, plus one
ERROR that is a HARNESS artifact of my own making, not a regression:
`tests/unit/test_identity_perf_1cc0.py::test_empty_map_falls_back_to_per_event_resolver` tripped the
conftest `_no_repo_commits` guard with "Test moved the repo HEAD (3a17e9a76e -> 0bc899725f)" — that
is the guard noticing MY `git commit` landing while the suite was still running. Re-ran that file
alone afterwards: 5 passed. Recording it so a reader of the log does not mistake it for a real
failure (and as a note to self: do not commit while the unit tier is running).

Commit in worktree `/Users/joeoakhart/wt-afeb` (branch `fix/afeb-class-bypass`):
**`0bc899725f1c32907f7293e3130cc4aecf75f3e8`** — "afeb: route hand-built sub-calls by class",
5 files changed, 540 insertions, `rebar-ticket: afeb-bc04-3265-4747` verified with
`rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev HEAD` -> OK. Not pushed; the orchestrator cherry-picks it onto the
Gerrit stack.

Files: `src/rebar/llm/enrich.py`, `src/rebar/llm/overlap/judge.py`, `src/rebar/llm/operations.py`,
`src/rebar/llm/code_review/workflow_ops.py` (+60 lines total, all of it the binding plus the
reasoning comment), and the new `tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py` (480 lines).
`src/rebar/llm/overlap/wire.py` was in budget but needed NO change.
